name: Thistlenettle's Badge
summary: In the Deadmines, Thistlenettle's Badge is all that remains after a tunnel collapse.

sections.title: The Explorers' League in the Deadmines
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood sealed Moonbrook and the tunnels beneath it, prospectors from Ironforge's Explorers' League worked Westfall's old gold mines. Foreman Thistlenettle and his crew were deep below when a tunnel collapsed and split them apart. His brother Wilder escaped to Stormwind City, but the foreman and several laborers remained trapped underground.

sections.title: A Grim Confirmation
sections.body: Foreman Thistlenettle died in the unsealed tunnels and rose as mindless undead among the collapsed shafts outside the main foundry. His Explorers' League Badge stayed with him. Wilder, his grieving brother, receives the badge, and it proves the foreman is dead.

faq.q: Who does this badge belong to?
faq.answer: The badge belonged to Foreman Thistlenettle, a dwarven miner and member of the Explorers' League. A tunnel collapse trapped him deep underground beneath Westfall.
Foreman Thistlenettle carries the badge in the Deadmines' monster-infested upper corridors, outside the main entrance to the Defias stronghold.
Wilder Thistlenettle wants the badge. The foreman's brother lives in Stormwind City's Dwarven District and awaits word of his kin's fate.

faq.q: Why were the Thistlenettle brothers in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: The brothers surveyed and prospected the mineral-rich caverns beneath Moonbrook for the Explorers' League. Hostile thieves and tunnel collapses ruined their expedition.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Foreman Thistlenettle carried the Explorers' League badge into Westfall. Recovering it keeps a fallen son of Ironforge from being forgotten.
As an Alliance member, you can bring closure to a grieving dwarf in Stormwind's Dwarven District.
